# Shape

**Figma:** Figma's own shapes (RECTANGLE, ELLIPSE with arcData, LINE, REGULAR_POLYGON, STAR; no library set)  
**Import:** `import { Shape } from "@zen-ds/react";`

Figma's native shapes in code — Rectangle, Ellipse with its arc (pie, ring, ring segment), Line, Arrow, Polygon and Star — for illustrations, marks and decoration drawn in Zen Studio, coloured with Zen tokens only.

## Use it for
- A decorative mark or illustration a designer drew in Zen Studio with R, O, L, ⇧L, Polygon or Star.
- A ring or pie built from an ellipse's arc (Start, Sweep, Ratio) where no chart component fits.
- A layer at Figma's X / Y in a free frame (a Box or Screen without auto layout): position="absolute" with px insets.

## Use something else for
- Data charts → Chart components (DonutChart, RadialChart, ProgressBar…): they carry labels, legends and accessible values.
- A divider line → Divider.
- A surface or card background → Box surface or Card.
- A status dot or badge on a component → that component's own prop (Avatar status, notification dot).

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Type | `type` | rectangle (default) · ellipse · line · arrow · polygon · star |
| Fill | `fill` | a Color/Background token by path (neutral-subtle · accent-solid · surface · support-blue-soft …) or none; default Background/Support/Neutral/Soft (Figma's #D9D9D9) |
| Stroke | `stroke / strokeWeight / strokeAlign` | a Color/Border token by path or none · px · inside (default) · center · outside |
| Arc | `arcStart / arcSweep / arcRatio` | ellipse: Start in degrees (clockwise from 3 o'clock) · Sweep % · Ratio % (the hole), Figma's arcData |
| Count / Ratio | `pointCount / starRatio` | polygon corners (3) · star tips (5) · star inner radius % (38.2) |
| Corner radius | `radius / radiusTopLeft …` | rectangle: Corner-Radius tokens |
| Transform | `rotation / opacity` | degrees, counter-clockwise positive (Figma's field) · layer opacity % |
| Size and place | `width / height / position / insetLeft / insetTop` | px or fill; a line has only its length; in a free frame insets are px (Figma X / Y) |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/shape.json`.

### Shape
Zen Shape: Figma's native shapes (Rectangle, Ellipse with its arc, Line, Arrow, Polygon, Star) for illustrations, marks and decoration drawn in Zen Studio. Not a Figma library component: it maps to Figma's own nodes (RECTANGLE, ELLIPSE with arcData, LINE, REGULAR_POLYGON, STAR) on export and import. Colours are Zen tokens only (`fill` from Color/Background, `stroke` from Color/Border); the rectangle's radius takes the Corner-Radius tokens. It sizes and places like a layout primitive: `width` / `height` (px or fill) and Figma's position props (in a free frame: `position="absolute"` with px insets).

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "children">, LayoutSizingProps, LayoutPositionProps, CornerRadiusProps`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `"hug" \| "fill" \| number` | — | Horizontal resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual width. `"hug"` (Hug contents): as wide as its content, never grows or stretches. `"fill"` (Fill container): in a row Stack it takes an equal share of the space left after each child's padding and may shrink to 0; in a column Stack it stretches across; in a Grid cell or a plain block it takes the full width. Fill children in a wrapping row need a `minWidth` to wrap. A number: Fixed width in px, which never shrinks in a flex row. Sizes include padding and border (border-box). (Container's `maxWidth` is a different prop: a token width, sm…full.) Prefer hug or fill; use Fixed only for widths that really are fixed (a side column, a preview frame). |
| `minWidth` | `number` | — | Minimum width in px (Figma min width). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0. |
| `maxWidth` | `number` | — | Maximum width in px (Figma max width), e.g. a readable line length for a Fill block of text. |
| `alignSelf` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end" \| "stretch"` | — | This element's alignment inside its parent: start · center · end · stretch across a Stack's direction (vertical in a row, horizontal in a column), vertical inside a Grid cell. Overrides the parent's `align` for this child. A `"fill"` size on the same axis still fills; in a column, alignSelf then places it once maxWidth stops it. No effect outside a Stack or Grid. |
| `height` | `"hug" \| "fill" \| number` | — | Vertical resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual height. `"hug"` (Hug contents): as tall as its content, never grows or stretches. `"fill"` (Fill container): in a column Stack it takes an equal share of the free height; it shrinks below its content only when the column has a height of its own (Fixed, Fill or maxHeight), else it keeps its content height (pass `minHeight={0}` for a scrolling child of a column sized from outside). In a row Stack it stretches to the row's height; in a Grid cell it fills the cell (over alignSelf); in a plain block it takes 100% (the parent needs a height). A number: Fixed height in px, which does not shrink in a column Stack. |
| `minHeight` | `number` | — | Minimum height in px (Figma min height). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0. |
| `maxHeight` | `number` | — | Maximum height in px (Figma max height). |
| `position` | `"static" \| "absolute"` | — | Figma "Ignore auto layout" (layoutPositioning ABSOLUTE). `"absolute"` takes the element out of its parent's flow and pins it to the parent Stack, Grid, Box or Card with `constraintX` / `constraintY`; siblings, `gap`, `justify` and the parent's Hug size ignore it, as in Figma. Siblings written after it paint above it (Figma auto layout "Last on top"), so put background media first. Default `"static"` (in flow). Only Stack, Grid and Box take it: wrap a Text or a component in a Box. Badges, status dots and a Card sub-action are component props, never insets. |
| `constraintX` | `"left" \| "right" \| "left-right" \| "center"` | — | Figma horizontal constraint, read only with `position="absolute"`: `left` (default, Figma Left) · `right` (Right) · `left-right` (Left & right: stretches between the two offsets, `width` is ignored) · `center` (Center: exact centre, the X offsets are ignored). Figma Scale is not offered (it needs percentages, which are not tokens). |
| `constraintY` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "top-bottom" \| "center"` | — | Figma vertical constraint, read only with `position="absolute"`: `top` (default) · `bottom` · `top-bottom` (Top & bottom: stretches between the two offsets, `height` is ignored) · `center` (exact centre). |
| `insetTop` | `ZenPadding \| number` | — | Offset from the parent's top edge on Spacing/Padding (none 0 · 3xs 2 · 2xs 4 · xs 8 · sm 12 · md 16 · lg 20 · xl 24 · 2xl 32 · 3xl 40 · 4xl 48; Figma Y snapped to the padding ladder). Read only when `constraintY` pins the top edge (`top`, `top-bottom`). Default none (flush). Measured from the parent's padding box, as Figma ignores the frame's padding for absolute children. A number is px: Figma's Y in a free frame (a Box or Screen without auto layout, where Zen Studio draws shapes and frames); it may be negative (the layer starts above the frame and clips). |
| `insetRight` | `ZenPadding \| number` | — | Offset from the parent's right edge on Spacing/Padding, or px in a free frame. Read only when `constraintX` is `right` or `left-right`. Default none. |
| `insetBottom` | `ZenPadding \| number` | — | Offset from the parent's bottom edge on Spacing/Padding, or px in a free frame. Read only when `constraintY` is `bottom` or `top-bottom`. Default none. |
| `insetLeft` | `ZenPadding \| number` | — | Offset from the parent's left edge on Spacing/Padding (Figma X snapped to the ladder), or Figma's X in px in a free frame. Read only when `constraintX` is `left` or `left-right`. Default none. |
| `radiusTopLeft` | `"none" \| Exclude<ZenScaleInput, "3xs" \| "3xsmall"> \| "full"` | — | Top-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topLeftRadius; none · 2xs 2 · xs 4 · sm 8 · md 12 · lg 16 · xl 20 · 2xl 24 · 3xl 28 · full), following the radius mode. A set corner wins over `radius`, as `paddingX` wins over `padding`; unset corners keep `radius`. Don't mix `full` with a finite corner (`radius="full" radiusBottomRight="xs"`): `full` is Corner-Radius/Rounded (1000px), so the browser scales every corner down to fit the box and the small one renders square. Use a finite radius (a chat tail: `radius="xl" radiusBottomRight="xs"`); `full` mixes only with `none`. |
| `radiusTopRight` | `"none" \| Exclude<ZenScaleInput, "3xs" \| "3xsmall"> \| "full"` | — | Top-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topRightRadius). Wins over `radius`. |
| `radiusBottomRight` | `"none" \| Exclude<ZenScaleInput, "3xs" \| "3xsmall"> \| "full"` | — | Bottom-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomRightRadius). Wins over `radius`. |
| `radiusBottomLeft` | `"none" \| Exclude<ZenScaleInput, "3xs" \| "3xsmall"> \| "full"` | — | Bottom-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomLeftRadius). Wins over `radius`. |
| `type` | `"rectangle" \| "ellipse" \| "line" \| "arrow" \| "polygon" \| "star"` | `"rectangle"` | The shape, as Figma's shape tools draw it: `rectangle` (default; Figma RECTANGLE), `ellipse` (ELLIPSE, with an arc), `line` (LINE: `width` is its length, `rotation` its angle, no height), `arrow` (a LINE with Figma's "Line arrow" end cap), `polygon` (REGULAR_POLYGON, `pointCount` corners) and `star` (STAR, `pointCount` tips, `starRatio`). |
| `fill` | `ShapeFill` | — | Fill: a Color/Background token by its path ("neutral-subtle", "accent-solid", "surface", "support-blue-soft"; list in `shapeFills`), or "none". Default: Background/Support/Neutral/Soft, Figma's light grey; a line or arrow has none. |
| `stroke` | `ShapeStroke` | — | Stroke: a Color/Border token by its path ("neutral-solid", "accent-subtle", "support-teal-solid"; `shapeStrokes`), or "none" (default; a line or arrow takes Border/Neutral/Solid). |
| `strokeWeight` | `number` | `1` | Stroke weight in px (Figma strokeWeight). Default 1. |
| `strokeAlign` | `"inside" \| "center" \| "outside"` | — | Where the stroke sits on the edge: `inside` (default, as Figma's shapes), `center` (a line's) or `outside`. |
| `radius` | `"none" \| Exclude<ZenScaleInput, "3xs" \| "3xsmall"> \| "full"` | — | Rectangle corner radius on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma cornerRadius); `radiusTopLeft` … override single corners. |
| `arcStart` | `number` | — | Ellipse arc Start in degrees, clockwise from 3 o'clock (Figma's Arc › Start; arcData.startingAngle). Default 0. |
| `arcSweep` | `number` | — | Ellipse arc Sweep in percent of a full turn (Figma's Arc › Sweep): 100 (default) the whole ellipse, 25 a quarter pie. |
| `arcRatio` | `number` | — | Ellipse arc Ratio in percent (Figma's Arc › Ratio; arcData.innerRadius): the hole of a ring or donut. Default 0. |
| `pointCount` | `number` | — | Polygon corners or star tips (Figma Count, 3 … 60). Default 3 for a polygon, 5 for a star. |
| `starRatio` | `number` | — | Star inner radius in percent of the outer one (Figma Ratio). Default 38.2. |
| `rotation` | `number` | — | Rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise positive, as Figma's rotation field. Turns the shape about its centre. |
| `opacity` | `number` | — | Layer opacity in percent (Figma's layer opacity, 0 … 100). Default 100. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible name for a shape that means something (a status mark, a chart legend dot); without it the shape is decorative and hidden from assistive tech. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | Ref to the shape's root element. |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
type ShapeFill = (typeof shapeFills)[number]
type ShapeStroke = (typeof shapeStrokes)[number]
type ZenMargin = "margin-comfortable" | "margin-compact"
type ZenPadding = "none" | ZenScaleInput | "4xl" | ZenMargin
type ZenScale = "3xs" | "2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl"
type ZenScaleInput = ZenScale | ZenScaleLong
type ZenScaleLong = "3xsmall" | "2xsmall" | "xsmall" | "small" | "medium" | "large" | "xlarge" | "2xlarge" | "3xlarge"
```

## ✅ Do
- Colour shapes with tokens only: fill from Color/Background, stroke from Color/Border (no hex).
- Give a shape that carries meaning a label (role=img); leave decoration unlabelled (hidden from assistive tech).
- Use px insets only inside a free frame (a Box or Screen without auto layout); inside auto layout let the frame place it.
- Keep a line's angle in rotation and its length in width, as Figma stores a LINE.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't draw charts, progress or ratings from shapes: use the components that carry values and labels.
- Don't use a Shape as a card or section background: use Box surface or Card.
- Don't pass hex or rgb colours: fill and stroke take Zen token paths only.

## Accessibility
- Decorative by default (aria-hidden); with label it is role=img named by the label.
- Colour alone must not carry meaning: pair a coloured mark with text.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape/token-paint` | error | A Shape's fill and stroke are Zen token paths (fill: Color/Background, stroke: Color/Border, or "none"), never hex, rgb or a var(). | `zen-allow-raw-shape-colour: <reason>` |
| `shape/px-offset-in-auto-layout` | warn | px insets are Figma's X / Y in a free frame (a Box without auto layout); inside a Stack or Grid an absolute layer's offsets are Spacing/Padding steps. | `zen-allow-px-offset: <reason>` |
| `shape/line-no-height` | warn | A line or arrow has no height (Figma's LINE): its length is width, its angle rotation, its weight strokeWeight. | `zen-allow-line-height: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
